# Q&A Log — Standards Alignment (System Architecture)
# Append-only. Do not edit past entries; add new dated entries instead.

## 2026-09-22 — Q0.1: Which standards form the reference panel for System Architecture?

**Context:** Same process used for Infrastructure and Networking — build
the standards panel first, from general knowledge, as a reference to seed
Definitions, then reconcile against what's actually cited once Definitions
is drafted.

**Bucket:** [Standard]/AI-draftable — bulk-drafted, not an org-specific
decision.

**Drafted:** ISO/IEC/IEEE 42010 (architecture description), ISO/IEC 25010
(software quality model/SQuaRE), OWASP ASVS, OWASP Top 10, OpenAPI
Specification, SemVer 2.0.0, NIST SP 800-53 (app-layer control families),
NIST SP 800-190 (container security), ISO/IEC 27001 Annex A.14, ANSI/ISO
SQL:2016, CIS Benchmarks (app/database platforms). Twelve-Factor App noted
separately as an industry methodology, not a formal standard.

**Status:** Pending explicit review — same as the pattern used for
Infrastructure and Networking's initial standards panels (reconciled
retroactively/proactively against Definitions).
